definitions.gloss: free-to-play; not spending real money on in-game purchases
definitions.explanation: Describes the practice of playing a mobile or online game without making any real-money purchases, or a player who does so. Contrasts with paying users who buy in-game items or currency.

examples.japanese: {無課金|むかきん}でクリアした。
examples.english: I cleared it without spending any money.

examples.japanese: {無課金|むかきん}プレイヤーでも{楽|たの}しめるゲームだ。
examples.english: It's a game that even free-to-play players can enjoy.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{無課金|むかきん}なのにランキング{上位|じょうい}に{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: He's ranked high even though he hasn't spent any money.

notes:
A modern internet and gaming term composed of {無|む} (without) + {課金|かきん} (in-app purchase/billing). Widely used in discussions of mobile games and online games with microtransaction models.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無課金|むかきん}プレイヤー — free-to-play player
- {無課金|むかきん}で{攻略|こうりゃく}する — to beat (a game) without paying
- {無課金|むかきん}{勢|ぜい} — the free-to-play crowd

RELATED WORDS:
- {課金|かきん} — in-app purchase; paying for game items
- {微課金|びかきん} — light spending (small purchases)
- {廃課金|はいかきん} — heavy spending (whale)
- ガチャ — gacha (random item draw mechanic)
